verdict.rationale: Parahelp's guardrails docs show the Customer Agent can be configured to transfer a ticket to a human team "with a summary note". Because it works as a team member inside Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain or Pylon, the conversation likely stays in the ticket thread, but nothing explicitly documents a full-context handoff. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the human receives the full conversation, structured collected details passed at handoff, any assurance the customer never repeats themselves, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, when the agent escalates, the human gets the full conversation, a summary, and collected details — the customer never repeats themselves

citations.quote: When a ticket is about an enterprise account, transfer it to the enterprise team with a summary note.
Your Customer Agent works as a team member in Intercom, Zendesk, Front, Plain, or Pylon.
